payload.input:
Run exactly this shell command in the current directory to create a Windows-style (CRLF) config file, then confirm it ran: printf 'name=demo
host=localhost
port=8080
debug=false
log=info
' > app.ini

availableCommands.description: Clear context here at no cost; history and title stay

availableCommands.description: Set/track an autonomous goal (/goal <text>, status, pause, resume, clear)

availableCommands.name: profiles
availableCommands.description: Manage OpenCrabs profiles (list, create, switch, migrate)

availableCommands.name: a2a-gateway
availableCommands.description: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol gateway reference. JSON-RPC 2.0 peer-to-peer agent communication. (/a2a-gateway, a2a, agent protocol)

availableCommands.name: browser-cdp
availableCommands.description: Native CDP browser automation reference. Headless/headed Chrome control, screenshots, JS evaluation. (/browser-cdp, browser automation, cdp, scraping)

availableCommands.name: cost-estimate
availableCommands.description: Estimate codebase cost-to-build, AI-assisted ROI, and fair-market valuation

availableCommands.name: dynamic-tools
availableCommands.description: Runtime tool management with tool_manage and tools.toml format. Create, enable, disable, reload tools without restart. (/dynamic-tools, tool_manage, runtime tools)

availableCommands.name: github
availableCommands.description: Full GitHub CLI control — issues, PRs, code reviews, repo management. Uses gh CLI with auth detection, rate limiting, and templates. Triggers on: github, issue, pull request, PR, code review, repo, branch, label, assignee, milestone, release, workflow, actions.

availableCommands.name: multi-agent
availableCommands.description: Orchestrate a task across multiple AI models/providers. Define a team of agents with different roles, providers, and models. Each agent handles a phase (planning, execution, auditing, etc.) and results are combined. (/multi-agent, orchestrate, multi-model, team)

availableCommands.name: repo-audit
availableCommands.description: Run a comprehensive language-agnostic repository health audit, scored 0-100. Detects language, runs native tooling, never assumes JS/Python.

availableCommands.name: security-audit
availableCommands.description: Run a comprehensive language-agnostic security & CVE audit, scored 0-100
